title: Balance a production line
summary: Split a line into one function block per machine, and send alternate blanks to each so that both machines make four products.
scope: Tests give deterministic native POSIX host evidence on a simulated plant scene; they are not physical, hardware, HIL, or certification evidence.
objectives: Move the control of one machine into a function block and use one instance for each machine.
Balance two machines of different speeds by alternating the blanks between them.

stages.title: Objective
stages.body: In src/ProductionLine.st, turn the inline control of machine A into a function block Cell, call one instance for machine A and another for machine B, and light Green when both have finished four cycles.
stages.checkpoint: Both machines run the same function block, so a change to the block changes both.

stages.title: Predict
stages.body: Before running, count the blanks: eight arrive, one every six seconds, and the arm sends every second one to machine B; machine A needs 3 s per cycle and machine B 6 s, so each makes four with the same block.
stages.checkpoint: Each machine feeds until a blank has entered, waits for Ready before it pulses Start, and feeds again after Done; no Start is a misfire.

stages.title: Edit
stages.body: Correct this starter omission, save it, then run: The starter controls only machine A, written inline; move that control into a function block, call it for machine A and for machine B, and light Green when both have finished four cycles.
stages.checkpoint: The visible scenario must pass with saved host evidence.

stages.title: Run
stages.body: In Tests, choose the saved zplc.json and run only the balanced-production-line scenario; watch the 3D view while it runs.
stages.checkpoint: The required scenario is named balanced-production-line and contains {{assertions}} assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Watch both machines in the 3D view and read produced: and misfires: in the facts text.
stages.checkpoint: Machine A makes a lid and machine B a base on each cycle, and misfires stays at zero.

stages.title: Reflect
stages.body: The EVENTUALLY assertion proves both machines made a product and both bins received one; the ALWAYS assertion proves no Start was a misfire and nothing fell.
stages.checkpoint: The grade cannot count the products: it reads Green, which the program lights from its own count, so read produced: in the facts for the real number. It does not establish physical machine timing, hardware timing, HIL, or certification.

hints.text: A function block keeps its own variables in each instance: Step, the timers and the count belong inside Cell, so two instances never share them.
Pass Active, Seen, Ready and Done in and take Feed, Start and Cycles out; set Start to FALSE at the top so that it lasts one scan, and call each instance once per scan.

faultCases: The starter controls only machine A, written inline; move that control into a function block, call it for machine A and for machine B, and light Green when both have finished four cycles.
